artDirection.oneSentenceRead: A compact furnace-stack-tank process train with a dark recessed charging well, not a beige cube with a glowing line.

Rect takeoff, rect-to-round, mitered elbow, oxidized stack with hoops, rain cap above the outlet.
Heat-stained routed pipe with miters, flanges, clamp, tank nozzle.
Matte oxide-red paint on a formed vessel; two saddles/base plates; knuckle ends; manway/lid.
Four tapered gusseted feet; visible gap to the pad.
Hood, socket, recessed lens at the flue neck. Beauty emission 0.
